lines.en: A hop, a peck, another hop.

lines.zh: 我在地上一蹦一蹦地挪。
lines.en: I shift along the ground in little hops.
I peck the ground, then move on.

lines.zh: 我小跑的时候，翅膀会张开。
lines.en: When I trot, my wings open a little.
I go around the stones and keep to the grass.

lines.zh: 我走得很急，像有事要做。
lines.en: I walk briskly, as if I have business.
I keep to the bushes, the better to hide.
My tail bobs up and down.
I walk a stretch and look up.
I hop over toward my companions.

lines.zh: 枯叶在我脚下响，藏不住。
lines.en: Dry leaves rustle under me — no hiding.

lines.zh: 我低头找了一会儿，又走。
lines.en: I search the ground a while, then move on.
Short steps, but quick.
I slip into the brush and out again.
I hop onto a low stone and off again.
I walk as if hurrying after something.
I stand on a branch with my head tilted.
I preen my feathers.
I call out suddenly.
I listen to insects far off.

lines.zh: 我把头转过去，又转回来。
lines.en: I turn my head away, then back.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀收到背上，理了理。
lines.en: I fold my wings back and tidy them.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只有眼睛在动。
lines.en: I hold still, only my eyes moving.
I wait for a bug to appear.
I fluff my feathers for warmth.
A shadow on the ground. I look at it.
I hop to another branch.
I close one eye.
You stand; I look up.

lines.zh: 你一站过来，影子就盖住我。
lines.en: One step closer and your shadow covers me.

lines.zh: 你手里的，是面包还是石头？
lines.en: Is that bread or a stone in your hand?
You come closer; I hop away.
Keep staring and I will fly off.
I retreat two hops up the branch.
Are you going to throw stones?
My call is a warning.
I can see the cat behind you.
I can fly off at any moment.
I cry out and hop away.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的一撮绒毛飞了。
lines.en: A puff of my down flies loose.
One wing has gone crooked.
The pain makes me flutter.
I retreat to a higher branch.
I have so little blood.
My little breast is fluttering.
My leg limps.
My cry comes out ugly.

lines.zh: 再碰，我这身羽毛就保不住。
lines.en: One more touch and I lose these feathers.
Are those seeds?
I stare at it without moving.
Scatter it on the ground and I will dare.
I will not eat from a hand.
This one is really too small.
I peck once and step back.
Shift back and I will dare to eat.
Other birds are watching.
I will take it and fly.
Scatter a little more.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底从我头顶过去了。
lines.en: Your sole passed right over my head.
I hop half a foot clear.
My feathers got mussed.
I fluttered twice before landing.
Do not grab me with your hand.
I weigh far less than you.
That bump sent me up to a low branch.

lines.zh: 我从你脚边溜到另一边。
lines.en: I dart from your feet to the other side.

lines.zh: 你踢起的土落在我身上。
lines.en: The dirt you kicked landed on me.
Closer, and I fly.
It is that season now.

lines.zh: 我在枝上叫，叫得很好听。
lines.en: I call from the branch. It sounds fine.
An answer came. From the other side.
I hop over, landing lightly.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，看同一个方向。
lines.en: We stand side by side, facing the same way.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀抖开又收起来。
lines.en: I spread my wings and fold them.
The nest should be on a higher branch.
I carry a blade of grass.
Do not look up this tree.
She flew; I follow.
This grain is half a meal for me.
This one is too hard to bite.
I take a dry stalk of grass.
Too long; it drags.

lines.zh: 虫子扭了一下，我叼紧了。
lines.en: The worm wriggles; I grip it tighter.
I shake it twice and swallow.
This crumb is one bite.
I carry it up to a branch.
This feather is not mine.
I drop it from the tree.
Something moves on the ground.
I tilt my head to see.
That on the ground is a worm.
I hop one step closer.
It is watching me too.
I open my wings, ready to spring.
The distance is short.
I lower my body.
It twitched. I saw it.
I stretch my neck and peck.
Missed. It ran.
I chase two small hops.

lines.zh: 它动一下，我的头就偏一点。
lines.en: Each time it moves, my head tilts a little.
It went under a leaf.
I hop over and wait for it.
My head bobs.
It is in the soil. I cannot see it.
I scratch twice with a foot.
It came out from under the leaf.
I hop back a good step.
It is braver than me.
I try one more peck.
I edge half a step closer, ready to fly.
It is faster than me, but I can wait.
I peck once. Light.
My beak is short and sharp.

lines.zh: 我扑了一下翅膀，扬起灰。
lines.en: A beat of my wings kicks up dust.
That only startled it.

lines.zh: 我蹬出一脚，抓了它的脸。
lines.en: I kick out and rake its face.

lines.zh: 它胳膊一动，我就上了枝。
lines.en: One arm swing and I am on the branch.
I peck your finger.
You laughed at that.
I peck and duck away; I do not brawl.
I only want it away from my nest.
I stand up in the nest.
My feathers are still wet.

lines.zh: 我第一次张嘴，叫出了声。
lines.en: I open my beak and a sound comes.
Shadows under the tree. Safe.
I shake and my feathers spread.
I know this wood.
I hop to the nest rim and look down.
Outside is so much bigger than the nest.

lines.zh: 我试着扇翅，飞了一小段。
lines.en: I try my wings and fly a short way.
I land on a low branch.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我的羽毛就卷了。
lines.en: Fire curls my feathers.

lines.zh: 我从枝上掉下去，翻了半圈。
lines.en: I fall from the branch, tumbling.

lines.zh: 水一下就没过我，我乱扑。
lines.en: Water closes over me; I thrash.
The blast blows me several blocks.

lines.zh: 箭羽从我翅根穿了出去。
lines.en: The arrow passed through the base of my wing.

lines.zh: 我全身一麻，飞不起来了。
lines.en: A numbness takes me; I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 我太饿了，连叫都没力气。
lines.en: Too hungry even to call.

lines.zh: 雷声震得我从枝上掉下来。
lines.en: The thunder knocks me off the branch.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇不动，我直直往下。
lines.en: My wings will not catch. Straight down.
